verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Kosmos as autonomously running a full research workflow: it reads literature, writes and executes analysis code, generates and tests hypotheses, and produces a comprehensive, auditable cited report. The Literature agent can also take on a deep review that synthesizes conflicting evidence across hundreds of papers, which goes clearly beyond a single-pass summary. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the autonomous multi-step behavior, and documentation of how the investigation loop works (step depth, iteration, run duration); Kosmos is also described as taking a research objective plus datasets rather than a bare question.
